beats.text: The couples who post the most aren't always the happiest.
Researchers ran three studies on how people show their relationship on Facebook. One followed them day by day.
On days people felt more insecure about their relationship, they posted more about it. And who wants it most visible?
People with anxious attachment. The ones who worry their partner might leave.
Avoidant people did the opposite. No couple photo, no relationship status.
So a feed full of couple photos isn't proof of love. Sometimes it's a quiet ask for reassurance.

sources: Emery, Muise, Dix & Le (2014), 'Can You Tell That I'm in a Relationship? Attachment and Relationship Visibility on Facebook', Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin 40(11), 1466-1479. Three studies incl. a daily diary: avoidant people less visible (fewer relationship statuses / couple profile pictures); anxious people want more visibility; on days people felt more insecure than usual they posted more about their relationship. Via SPSP blog / Psychology Today (2014).
